build_ClassyModel_from_config: build a ClassyModel instance from a configuration dictionary using the from_config class method
convert_nn_module_to_ClassyModel: convert an existing PyTorch nn.Module into a ClassyModel using the from_model class method
attach_heads_to_ClassyModel: attach ClassyHead objects to named blocks of a ClassyModel using the set_heads method
get_classy_state_for_checkpointing: get the model state dictionary with trunk and heads separated using the get_classy_state method
execute_heads_on_ClassyModel: execute all attached heads on block outputs and return their results using the execute_heads method
